channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: League Action at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium Grade 2 Mens (Navan vs Julianstown), Grade 6 Mixed (Navan ‘A’ vs Mullagh), plus two courts open from 8:30pm. Juvenile night is league matches only.'
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 5 Matches Played, 13 More to Come
item.description: A busy week of league and cup action: two league draws, a big cup win for Grade 7 Mixed, and a tough away loss for Grade 2 Men’s. Next week ramps up with 13 matches across league and cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 12 Matches Completed: Big League Wins & Cup Drama
item.description: A packed week of 12 matches featuring a derby, strong league wins, and dramatic cup scorelines.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Navan 'A' vs Trim 'A' + Members’ Courts from 8pm
item.description: Cup action this Wednesday as Navan 'A' take on Trim 'A' in the Grade 5 Men’s cup match. Two courts available for members from 8pm, with juveniles playing league matches only.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 11 Matches Played
item.description: A busy week of 11 matches featuring big wins, hard-fought draws, dramatic cup action, and a packed 13-game schedule ahead.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: No Club Night Tonight: Three Matches, One Packed Schedule
item.description: No club night for members tonight as the courts are fully booked with three matches: Grade 3 Mens (Navan vs Ardee B) and two Grade 5 Mens ties (Navan vs Bailieboro, Navan B vs Ardee B).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Busy Week: 10 Matches, Big League Wins & 3 Cup Victories
item.description: A huge week with 10 matches played: standout league wins across Mixed and Ladies teams, two hard-fought Grade 2 Mixed draws, and three dramatic cup victories including two 7–5 thrillers. Another 11 matches await next week.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Unbeaten Start to 2026: 2 Wins & 3 Draws in a Big Week
item.description: An unbeaten start to 2026 with 2 wins and 3 draws across five matches, and a huge week ahead with at least 12 fixtures including Cup action starting Sunday.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 25 Results Recap
item.description: A thrilling week with intense matches, comebacks, and league victories. Catch up on all the action and see which teams are heading to the finals.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 24 Fixtures
item.description: Final week of the season with 9 key matches, including interleague, playoffs, and semi-finals.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 19 Fixtures
item.description: Check out the action-packed Week 19 fixtures with 14 matches, including league games and cup ties. Don't miss the Mixed League finale and prepare for the playoffs!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
